notes: Added missing schema/contract, API exposure, and test coverage stories for FEAT-6.

change_log.note: Add schema layer for consent tiers
Expose consent workflow via backend API
Ensure correctness and compliance via tests
Ensure all services respect consent decisions

stories.title: Consent Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define Pydantic models and internal data contracts for representing consent tiers, consent state transitions, and storage rules, ensuring consistent validation across services.

stories.title: Consent API Endpoints
stories.description: Expose consent workflow via FastAPI endpoints, including capture of initial consent, upgrade to Tier 2, and retrieval of current consent status for session enforcement.

stories.title: Consent Workflow Test Suite
stories.description: Implement unit and integration tests validating consent tier enforcement, de-identification behavior, API responses, and edge cases such as invalid transitions or missing consent.

stories.title: Cross-Service Consent Enforcement Integration
stories.description: Integrate consent checks into all relevant domain services (lead capture, unknown question handling, safety logging) to ensure no service bypasses consent enforcement before storing or processing user data.
